name: Context Arena
intro: Context Arena 当前展示 Google DeepMind MRCRv2 Full 8-needle 长上下文结果。每个模型独立回答固定用例，不进行两两对战，也不使用 LLM 裁判；代码按 12 字符哈希门控后用 SequenceMatcher 逐题评分，再按长度桶汇总 Pointwise、Cum AVG 与 AUC。
build_method: GDM MRCRv2以格式/主题/风格三元组构造多轮长对话，随机交错不同回答与干扰项，并要求检索第i个回答及12字符哈希
metric: SequenceMatcher均值, Pointwise, Cum AVG@128K/@1M, AUC@128K/@1M
task_type: 长上下文序数检索, 多轮共指
eval_feature: 当前Full 8-needle, 12字符哈希门, 独立模型运行, 无对战与LLM裁判
scale: 当前看板为8-needle；8K至1M八个长度桶；每桶运行数由看板数据决定
build_method_en: GDM MRCRv2 builds long multi-turn transcripts from format/topic/style triplets, interleaves distinct responses and distractors, and asks for the ith response with a 12-character hash
eval_feature_en: Current Full 8-needle view, 12-character hash gate, independent model runs, no battles or LLM judge
intro_en: Context Arena currently presents Google DeepMind MRCRv2 Full 8-needle long-context results. Each model answers fixed cases independently—there is no head-to-head battle and no LLM judge. Code gates each example on a 12-character hash, applies SequenceMatcher, and aggregates scores by length bin as Pointwise, Cum AVG, and AUC.
scale_en: Current 8-needle view; eight bins from 8K to 1M; run counts are dashboard-dependent
metric_en: Mean SequenceMatcher ratio, Pointwise, Cum AVG@128K/@1M, AUC@128K/@1M

drawio_review_note: Current source is google-deepmind/eval_hub commit 67b7fd29b2205ee0a3226e0d3e5d74140a253b42, which releases GDM MRCRv2 and cites Michelangelo arXiv:2409.12640v2. The live contextarena.ai client and API were checked on 2026-07-18: the active view is GDM-MRCRv2 Full 8-needle across eight bins from 8K to 1M, and live run counts are not fixed at 100 per bin. OpenAI MRCR revision f4c69fae7cf81f7ca26b9fee34b392a50f6b8a1d is retained only as historical lineage, including its 2025-12-05 bug-fix note; it is not the current data flow. GDM MRCRv2 builds format/topic/style-keyed user–assistant turns with distinct responses and distractors, then asks for the ith response prefixed by a unique random string. Models run independently: there is no head-to-head battle and no LLM judge, and tool access must be reported. The official metric finds the last occurrence of the required 12-character hash, assigns zero if absent, and applies difflib.SequenceMatcher to the content after that hash. Context Arena averages examples per bin, reports Pointwise and unweighted Cum AVG with missing bins as zero, and computes normalized AUC by trapezoidal integration over linear bin endpoints, also treating missing bins as zero.
